semantic_claims.statement: IsCallable is an abstract operation named in section 7.2.3 that takes one argument named argument and returns a Boolean.
If argument is not an Object, IsCallable returns false.
If argument has a [[Call]] internal method, IsCallable returns true.
If argument is an Object but does not have [[Call]], IsCallable returns false.
For a fixed argument, IsCallable is deterministic and total over its input type (returns either true or false).
No exceptional completion, explicit undefined behavior, or implementation-defined behavior is stated in section 7.2.3 IsCallable.
